question: At the qualified R12 budget-108 restoration, is the unique final record whose removal destabilizes restoration also sufficient by itself to restore the budget-107 class structure when all other final additions are fixed non-novel duplicates?
hypothesis: Exactly one surface will have a novel sample-108 anchored-support tuple. A fixed-size targeted-rescue arm containing that actual final record and sample-107 duplicates for the other 26 surfaces will induce nine correct alias triplets with zero splits or cross-entity collisions, while an all-sham arm containing sample-107 duplicates for all 27 surfaces will retain ten classes, eight correct triplets, and one split.

prior_evidence.observation: Across all 27 single-record replacements, actual budget 108 had exactly one novel-support addition and exactly one destabilizing intervention; every and only removal of novel support reversed restoration, and all non-novel replacements preserved the restored membership.

scope_statement: This experiment changes one R12 dimension: necessity is converted to an equal-record-count sufficiency intervention. Streams, motifs, seeds, representation, induction, capacity, and evaluator-only audit remain unchanged. It makes no population, task-learning, or language-competence claim.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, live-interface, CKB-plane, or cross-lane authority

arms_and_inputs.budget107_control: Exact first 107 records of each of the 27 frozen independent entity-family streams.
arms_and_inputs.actual108_control: Exact first 108 records of each frozen stream; must reproduce R12 full restoration and exactly one novel-support addition.
arms_and_inputs.all_sham108_control: Budget 107 plus, for every surface, a byte-identical copy of that surface's sample index 106 record.
arms_and_inputs.targeted_rescue108_arm: Budget 107 plus the actual sample index 107 record for the unique surface whose exact anchored-support tuple is absent at budget 107; every other surface receives a byte-identical copy of its own sample index 106 record.
arms_and_inputs.target_selection: Before class induction, scan surfaces 0 through 26 and select the sole surface for which sample index 107 contributes an exact five-byte anchored-support tuple absent from that surface's budget-107 support. Zero or multiple targets is invalid.
arms_and_inputs.evaluation: Exact support-set deltas, class cardinality, and evaluator-only entity-membership audit; no task model is trained.

seeds.all_arms: Exact R6-R12 independent seeds. Interventions introduce no random draw and use only frozen within-surface sample indices 106 and 107.

controls: Budget 107 and actual 108 must reproduce R12 before intervention output is emitted.
All arms use identical streams, selected motifs, phase coordinate, exact-support representation, class inducer, and evaluator.
Actual, all-sham, and targeted-rescue arms each contain exactly 108 records per surface and 2916 records total.
The all-sham and targeted arms differ at exactly one frozen final-record position; target selection uses per-surface support novelty before induction and no semantic label.
Entity and family labels are unavailable to target selection and induction and enter only the post-induction audit.
validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
The local deterministic R12 probe reproduces exactly one novel and one destabilizing intervention before R13 output is emitted.
Target selection yields exactly one surface; all 26 non-target additions equal their within-surface sample index 106 record and the target addition equals its sample index 107 record.
Every arm has its frozen cardinality; all context indices and bytes are in range; all 36 unordered entity pairs are audited once per arm.
All metrics are finite and full Go regression passes before the probe.
No tokenizer, task training, external model, network call, capacity growth, fuzzy matching, threshold change, seed search, adaptive arm selection, or evaluator leakage occurs.

classification_rules.single_record_sufficiency_supported: Validity and controls pass; the targeted rescue has exactly one novel addition, exactly reproduces actual-108 class membership, and restores nine correct triplets while the zero-novel all-sham control remains split.
classification_rules.single_record_not_sufficient: Validity and controls pass; the all-sham control remains split but the targeted rescue does not fully restore actual-108 membership.
classification_rules.record_count_only_supported: Validity and controls pass; the zero-novel all-sham control fully restores.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity and controls pass, but results satisfy none of the preceding scientific rules.
classification_rules.negative_control_failure: Budget 107, actual 108, R12 replication, target uniqueness, or all-sham construction fails a frozen threshold.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents all four frozen arms.
classification_rules.invalid: Any identity, construction, target-cardinality, support accounting, leakage, evaluator-boundary, determinism, finite-metric, or qualification criterion fails.

stop_conditions: Stop invalid before science on parent, North Star, R12 replication, target uniqueness, construction, build, or frozen-package drift.
After R13 output begins, complete all four arms and all frozen evaluations unless infrastructure prevents it.
Do not inspect alternate target rules or duplicate positions, add arms, or alter representation, controls, metrics, thresholds, budgets, capacity, or classification after observing R13 output.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: No arm, target rule, duplicate source, budget, context distribution, sample sequence, seed, representation rule, class learner, control, metric, threshold, capacity, stop condition, or interpretation may change after primary R13 output.
